test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A test has 150 questions divided into three sections: Section A (30 questions), Section B (60 questions), and Section C (60 questions). A candidate answers 60% of Section A, 50% of Section B, and 40% of Section C correctly. If the minimum passing score is 60%, how many more questions must the candidate answer correctly to pass?
solution:
**Given:**

Total questions = 150

Section A = 30 questions

Section B = 60 questions

Section C = 60 questions

Correct answers:

Section A = 60%

Section B = 50%

Section C = 40%

Passing percentage = 60%

**Formula used:**

Correct answers = Percentage × Total questions

**Calculations:**

⇒ Correct in Section A = 60% × 30 = 18

⇒ Correct in Section B = 50% × 60 = 30

⇒ Correct in Section C = 40% × 60 = 24

⇒ Total correct answers = 18 + 30 + 24 = 72

⇒ Passing marks = 60% × 150 = 90

⇒ More questions needed = 90 − 72 = 18

**∴ The candidate must answer 18 more questions correctly to pass.**
